fields.experiment: experiment label as DEV_RESULTS names it (records-derived name where DEV_RESULTS has no entry)
fields.bar: the frozen criterion as DEV_RESULTS (or PREREG) states it; null when none applies
fields.met: true / false as DEV_RESULTS reads the frozen criterion; null when DEV_RESULTS gives no reading for this session
fields.met_scope: session: the criterion is read on this session's final; stream: the criterion is read on the stream this session is one round of
fields.reading: the outcome words of DEV_RESULTS, shortened
fields.null_kind: only when met is null. no_reading: a criterion applies but DEV_RESULTS gives no reading (the table counts the field as missing). not_applicable: no criterion applies to this session (a stop before launch, a gate DEV_RESULTS reads as not applicable, a lineage session that carries no criterion)
fields.reason: why met is null, or how met was derived when DEV_RESULTS does not say met or missed in those words
fields.dev_results_heading: the exact DEV_RESULTS heading of the reading (the table script checks it exists and finds its line)
fields.session_named_under: the heading whose section names the session id, when it differs from the reading's heading
fields.secondary: other readings DEV_RESULTS gives for the same final (E3, C, B beside another mark)
fields.notes: facts from DEV_RESULTS or PREREG that a reader of the row needs
